task_completion.visual_evidence: The UI shows the specific section details for 'Introduction to Biology' during 'Period 2' being edited or selected.

task_completion.visual_evidence: A dropdown or text field for 'Room' shows 'Science Lab' selected for the Period 2 section.

task_completion.description: Agent saves the modifications to the Period 2 section.

integrity.description: The agent used the OpenSIS web interface rather than direct database manipulation via terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the browser, mouse movements, and clicks within the OpenSIS GUI.

integrity.description: The agent did not use the command line to execute SQL queries to update the database.
integrity.visual_evidence: The terminal is not used for 'psql' or 'mysql' commands to modify the 'course_sections' table.

integrity.description: The agent navigated through the menu system rather than jumping directly to a deep-linked URL if not provided.
integrity.visual_evidence: Sequential screenshots show the agent clicking through 'Scheduling' or 'Courses' menus.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The target course is 'Introduction to Biology'. There are two sections: Period 2 (must be moved from Room 304 to Science Lab) and Period 3 (must stay in Room 304). The agent must use the admin/Admin@123 credentials. Success is defined by Period 2 being in Science Lab and Period 3 remaining in Room 304.
